wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.name: Automatic checks runner
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.description: Runs the set of automatic checks in order and combines them into one pass or fail result.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.name: Check building block
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.description: Shared base for all automatic checks, including a safe way to run a program and capture what it prints.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.name: Pre-push pipeline check
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.description: Runs the same checks the target repository's own pull-request pipeline would run, so failures show up before pushing.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.name: Code checks
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.description: Groups the code-quality checks: style, types, tests and coverage.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.name: Test coverage check
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.description: Measures how much of the code the tests actually exercise.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.name: Type check
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.description: Runs the type checker to catch mismatched kinds of data before the code runs.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.name: JavaScript checks
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.description: Runs the build, style and test commands of JavaScript projects.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.name: Test run
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.description: Runs the Python tests and records what passed and failed.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.name: Style check
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.description: Runs the style checker and turns its findings into pass or fail results.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.name: Unreliable test check
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.description: Re-runs tests the work added or changed and blocks if any gives different answers on different runs.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.name: Checks per tech stack
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.description: Picks the right set of automatic checks for each kind of project, such as Python or JavaScript.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.name: Check result formats
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/evaluators.description: Defines how a single check result, a finding and the whole verification report are recorded.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/quality.py.name: Quality loop
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/quality.py.description: Scores the work, assembles independent critics and patches problems, refusing to pass until required critics wrote their own reviews.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/review.py.name: Read-only review
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/review.py.description: Audits a repository or folder with the critic panel without changing it; links outside the target are not followed and its git settings cannot run commands.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/verify_che.name: Final verify checks
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/verify_che.description: Runs the last automatic checks of a job and records any human decision to accept a finding.
